g.text: Four source-selected loci: paired RNA and fragment-record changes
Primary: paired positive depths, pooled summaries, M33 basic-transcript ±2 kb TSS-window unions
Source records retain opposite strands; readSupport is not a weight. Each modality has its own total-depth denominator.
Finite libraries, shared CTRL; overlap counts are not ARC peak cut-site counts or a causal regulatory-memory measure.
